properties.displayName: Enforce Microsoft Default Rule Set for WAF
properties.description: Ensures Application Gateway and Premium Azure Front Door WAF policies include Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet in their managed rules. The required version defaults to 2.2 and can be set to an empty string for type-only enforcement.

metadata.displayName: Application Gateway WAF Default Rule Set effect
metadata.description: Controls whether Application Gateway WAF policies without Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet are audited, denied, or ignored.

metadata.displayName: Premium Azure Front Door WAF Default Rule Set effect
metadata.description: Controls whether Premium Azure Front Door WAF policies without Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet are audited, denied, or ignored.
Required Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet version. Defaults to 2.2; set to an empty string to enforce the rule set type without a version requirement.
